notes: The printed nameplate confirms the commercial model name ANJ-4.2KW-24V-WIFI and states 4200 VA/4200 W, 24 VDC input, 230 VAC 50/60 Hz output at 18.3 A and a 28 A AC charger; it carries the serial that the register block at 186-197 decodes (value withheld) and does not print an SMG-II or ANJ-4200-24V name. Runtime resolves to the generic SMG family 4200 descriptor with layout 11, model code 30721, rated power 4200 W and rated cell count 2, while register 172 device-name text is empty. The shared fingerprint and the rated power/output settings select the profile; the program version string 7801_A6250708v1 was observed on this unit as diagnostic metadata and is not a selection condition.

This record reuses the existing built-in smg_variant_4200 profile on the documented classic SMG RS232 V1 map and adds no model-scoped overlay. Shadow-learning captures associated with cloud device code 6514 came from an older donor unit and explain only how that built-in map was obtained; no cloud learning has been run on this unit, so its cloud control surface remains unknown.

The hardware checks contributed with this record were run by the reporting owner through Home Assistant on 2026-11-03: buzzer mode (303), LCD backlight (305) and LCD auto-return (306) were written, read back and restored. The remaining controls, including every setpoint, are not per-capability validated.

known_limitations: Controls are partial: buzzer mode, LCD backlight and LCD auto-return were written, read back and restored through Home Assistant on 2026-11-03, but the remaining writable controls, including every battery, charge-current and voltage setpoint, have no per-capability write/readback confirmation on this unit. Manual full-control override is an operator decision, not proof that a write is safe or effective.

Layout 11 and model code 0x7801 describe a shared SMG family fingerprint; another brand may use the same values. The commercial identity here rests on the printed nameplate model string and its serial (value withheld), and on the rated power this unit reports.

The 7801_A6250708v1 program version was observed on this unit and is diagnostic metadata, not a profile-selection condition: a blank or different version string still resolves to the same shared SMG family 4200 descriptor.

The device-name ASCII field at register 172 reads empty and runtime identity is bound to the fingerprint rather than the serial, so the serial is not used to select the profile. The serial block at registers 186-197 does decode to the unit's nameplate serial; the value is withheld from the catalog under its privacy rule.

Power-saving mode (register 307) is untested on this unit. The shared SMG default profile keeps this register blocked after a Sandisolar SMG-6200 returned Modbus exception 7 on write, while an Anenji ANJ-5KW-48V-WIFI sibling was cloud-confirmed; the outcome for this model is unknown.
knowledge_summary: Anenji ANJ-4.2KW-24V-WIFI is a 24 V 4.2 kW SMG-family inverter/charger whose printed nameplate states 4200 VA/4200 W, 24 VDC input, 230 VAC 50/60 Hz output at 18.3 A and a 28 A AC charger, and carries the serial that the register block at 186-197 decodes (value withheld). A live read-only probe resolved the generic layout 11, model 0x7801 and 4200 W descriptor and observed program version 7801_A6250708v1, which is diagnostic metadata rather than a profile-selection condition. Telemetry and the classic SMG read surface are confirmed; three cosmetic controls were written, read back and restored through Home Assistant in the contributed hardware checks, while the setpoint surface still needs per-capability validation before the model can claim confirmed control support.
